metadata.evaluation_phase: Phase A4 — HISC Vocabulary and Cross-Asset Improvements

limitations_and_leakage_protection.clustering_vs_pairwise_protocol: The current HISC algorithm implements online graph clustering via MongoDB collections (Complaint and IncidentCluster). The evaluation datasets (400 original pairs, 150 challenge pairs) are pairwise labeled relations. As a result, global partition-level clustering metrics (Adjusted Rand Index, Adjusted Mutual Information, BCubed F1) requiring full connected graph matrices cannot be computed without artificial graph synthesis. Instead, the evaluation rigorously measures pairwise link classification performance (duplicate, related, independent).
limitations_and_leakage_protection.leakage_protection: Zero incident_id leakage across train, val, and test partitions confirmed. Synthetic challenge set strictly separated from baseline fitting and validation threshold sweeping.
